top_signals.title: Real emails, hijacked payments: Two H1 2026 attack chains
top_signals.summary: Gen's H1 2026 Threat Report examines two separate attack chains. One used compromised business inboxes and browser manipulation in a banking-malware campaign, while the other used clipboard hijacking to redirect cryptocurrency payments. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Looking back at one of the group’s leading figures as Nihon Hidankyo marks 70 years
top_signals.summary: Mikiso Iwasa, who served as co-chair of Nihon Hidankyo, spent his life working for survivors of the 1945 atomic bombs while urging the world to abolish nuclear weapons.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Metabase SQLi zero-day exploited in customer data-theft attacks
top_signals.summary: A critical Metabase SQL injection vulnerability was exploited in zero-day attacks to breach customer instances in data theft attacks, known to impact Framework and Tally. [...]
